{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABc6lqBQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhGcu5Y", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 225, "title": "Remove the Cancel button from the extension Live UI", "body": "## Goal

Simplify the Chrome extension Live screen by **removing the user-facing Cancel button**. For the regular user flow, **Start** begins the session and **Stop** ends capture gracefully and finalizes pending graph work. If the user wants to abandon the session immediately instead, they can close the Live page/window. Do not add a replacement force-stop button or menu entry in this task; reconsider such a control only if a concrete need arises.

## Motivation

The permanent Start / Stop / Cancel controls are confusing: the distinction between Stop (drain/finalize pending work) and Cancel (abort immediately) is not evident, and a separate Cancel button is unnecessary for the intended workflow. In particular, Cancel should not suggest that all previously displayed/recorded output is discarded.

## Required implementation

- Remove the visible `Cancel` control (`#cancel-session`) from `extension/recorder.html`, along with its UI event handler and button disabled/enabled updates in `extension/recorder.js`.
- Adjust the recording controls' spacing/alignment and any relevant styling so **Start and Stop are the only ordinary recording-control buttons**, in desktop and narrow Live widths, consistent with the Concept A Live redesign (#223).
- **Keep `TabSession.cancel()` and `Pipeline.cancel()` and their internal cancellation behavior intact.** They are still needed for closing/unloading the Live page (`pagehide`), errors, initialization cleanup, cancellation of in-flight workers, and releasing capture/microphone/speaker resources. This is strictly a UI removal, not removal of the underlying safety/lifecycle API.
- Do not change graceful **Stop** semantics: it should still finalize/drain outstanding work where supported and leave completed output visible in Live. Existing handling of Stop during the loading/starting phase should remain valid, including internal cancellation if used there.
- Closing/navigating away from Live should still cancel active work and release resources without waiting for long-running summarization/translation; this behavior must not depend on the removed button.
- Keep all other Live controls and graph-driven **Graph Actions / Button nodes** unaffected. Do not remove user-defined graph buttons named “Cancel” or change the generic Button node contract.
- Update relevant UI documentation, help text and tests that expect the `#cancel-session` control. Avoid a dangling focus target, empty layout space, or references to a nonexistent element.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live recording toolbar shows Start / Stop and **no built-in Cancel** control; UI layout remains clean at standard and ~390px narrow widths.
- [ ] Start → Stop follows existing graceful completion and retains finished transcript/translation/summary output.
- [ ] Stop during loading/starting still works without requiring a Cancel button.
- [ ] Closing or navigating away from Live while work is active still aborts pending work and releases audio/worker resources (verify the current `pagehide` cleanup).
- [ ] Errors and session replacement do not leave ongoing capture or orphan workers.
- [ ] Graph Actions (user-defined Button nodes) and tabbed Display UI are unchanged.
- [ ] Automated/browser/MV3 regressions cover UI absence and the lifecycle behaviors; document which tests actually ran.

## Likely files

- `extension/recorder.html`
- `extension/recorder.js`
- `extension/recorder.css` (only if necessary)
- Extension/browser tests and UI documentation

Related: #223 (Concept A redesign), #219 (Graph Actions).

**Scope: UI removal only. No new force-stop UX, unrelated controls, or changes to graph/pipeline processing.**", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/225", "created_at": "2026-11-06T02:22:02Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/my-audio-to-text", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "72f3bcf95dcf467dbcb96dba8339f50a"}
